name: THY MOTHER TONGUE
source:
It's been eight years since the USSR went quiet.

Seeking warmth from the freezing ruins, a wandering girl discovers a language that shouldn’t exist.

[From [url=https://kiresu.itch.io/thy-mother-tongue]itch.io[/url]]
